description: This file declares the IpcLoop class, which manages IPC communication channels within the Rialto server manager. It provides methods for creating IPC channels, thread management, and interfacing with external IPC components.

classes.name: IpcLoop
classes.description: A class that manages an IPC communication loop, including thread handling and channel creation within the Rialto server manager.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of IpcLoop with a socket and client reference.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the IPC channel used by this loop.

methods.name: createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates and returns a blocking closure for IPC operations.

methods.name: createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns an RPC controller for managing RPC calls.

methods.name: ipcThread
methods.description: Private method that runs the IPC thread loop.
